Item 1A. Risk Factors
The following risk factors should be considered carefully.
Risks Related to Our Industry
Competition could adversely impact our market share and financial results.
Our target markets remain competitive, and competition may intensify with rapid technological change and new entrants. We may lose share to larger competitors with more resources.
Competition in the datacenter market
Several large customers are building their own accelerators, which could reduce demand for our products over time.
Export controls may restrict our ability to sell products to certain customers. The U.S. government has imposed licensing requirements on exports of our products to certain countries, and further restrictions could materially reduce our revenue.
17
General Risk Factors
Our stock price may be volatile and could decline significantly.
The market price of our common stock has fluctuated and may continue to fluctuate significantly in response to a number of factors, many of which are beyond our control.
Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments
None.

MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS.
RESULTS OF OPERATIONS
Net sales increased 10% to $27.4 billion, driven by strong demand for electrical products in data center and utility end markets, partially offset by lower volumes in the vehicle segment.
Net sales$27,448$24,87810%
Segment operating profit margins expanded as higher prices and productivity more than offset inflation and investments in capacity. Management expects to continue investing in capacity to meet demand for its electrical products across the portfolio.
Liquidity remained strong with cash flow from operations funding capital expenditures, dividends and share repurchases during the year, and the company maintained access to its revolving credit facilities throughout the period.
